data._comment: Snapshot read by hand from official pages on 2026-10-16. Not a live reader: it goes stale after 7 days under the freshness rule.

programs.name: Federal elective pay (direct pay) for governmental entities, solar investment credit (IRC 6417 / 48E)
programs.deadline_note: Solar property must be placed in service by 2027-12-31 (statute, 26 U.S.C. 48E(e)(4)(A), for facilities whose construction begins after 2026-07-04).
programs.quote: Tax-exempt and governmental entities can benefit from certain clean energy investment and production credits using new options enabled by legislation enacted in 2022.
programs.statute_quote: shall not apply to any qualified property placed in service by the taxpayer after December 31, 2027

programs.name: NYC Solar Schools program (DCAS, NYPA, NYC Public Schools): rooftop solar on DOE schools under power purchase agreements
programs.status_note: Ongoing: 130 installations done (27.5 MW) and 86 more in progress as of 2026-04-23. The release describes no enrollment process, and it is not known whether this building is in the pipeline.
programs.quote: 86 more public school solar projects, totaling 17.2 MW, are actively in progress.

programs.name: NYSERDA NY-Sun commercial and industrial solar incentive (Con Edison region)
programs.status_note: Current block status could not be confirmed from an official page on 2026-10-16: NYSERDA's dashboard blocked automated access. A March 2026 NYSERDA update was found only through search results and could not be read.

programs.name: NYC Local Laws 92 and 94 of 2019 (sustainable roofs): rule, not an incentive
programs.status_note: Applies to new buildings and existing buildings undergoing certain major roof renovations; the roof must have a solar photovoltaic system, a green roof system, or both, over any applicable roof.
programs.quote: a solar photovoltaic system, a green roof system, or a combination of the two
